plan.title: chore: retire Go from master (frozen installer bridge leftovers in toolchain:check, CI and CodeQL)

narratives.Description: Remove the last Go surfaces from master: go.mod, the two content/templates embed Go files, the go probe in toolchain:check and doctor, the Go text in setup:toolchain, both setup-go steps in ci.yml, the Go-only release.yml workflow, and the gomod Dependabot entry. Retire the legacy Go-installer bridge apparatus that only served Go builds: the lastGoInstaller SoT (packages/core/src/legacy-bridge), the verify:go-freeze and verify:bridge-drift gates and their CLI verbs, and the skipped --legacy-bridge release-e2e leg. Docs stop pointing at removed files and say the frozen bridge binaries stay on the published v0.58.0 release.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

The Go installer was frozen as the legacy stage-1 bridge (#1912, closed), and releases above the bridge tag already skip the Go build. Go still costs every CI run and still blocks local maintainer setup:

- `task check` runs `toolchain:check`, and that task still requires `go` (`tasks/toolchain.yml`).
- Both merge-gate jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` run `actions/setup-go` only to satisfy that check.
- CodeQL still runs `Analyze (go)` twice per PR.
- `task setup:toolchain` installs Go on Windows maintainer machines.
- The only Go sources left are `go.mod`, `content/templates/embed.go` and `content/templates/embed_test.go`.

## Proposed fix

Decide whether the frozen bridge still needs to be buildable from master. If it does not:
- remove `go.mod` and the two `embed*.go` files;
- remove `go` from `toolchain:check` and `setup:toolchain`;
- remove both `setup-go` steps from `ci.yml` and the Go job from `release.yml`;
- drop `go` from the CodeQL language matrix;
- keep `verify:go-installer-bridge` only if a surface still reads `lastGoInstaller`; otherwise retire it too.

If the bridge must stay buildable, keep it on its own tag or branch, and still remove Go from the master gates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `task check` passes on a machine without Go installed.
- [ ] No `setup-go` step and no CodeQL Go analysis run on PRs.
- [ ] `git ls-files '*.go' go.mod` returns nothing on master, or the issue records why the bridge sources stay.
- [ ] The frozen bridge binary that existing users depend on is still downloadable from its published release.

Refs #1912, #1972

narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer, I want master to have no Go toolchain, CI or source surfaces, so that task check, CI and local setup run without Go and stop paying for a frozen bridge.
narratives.Constraint: Operator decision (Scott, 2026-11-20): "Retire Go fully". master does not need to build the frozen Go installer bridge. The bridge binaries stay downloadable from the published v0.58.0 GitHub release (install-linux-amd64, install-linux-arm64, install-macos-universal, install-windows-amd64.exe, install-windows-arm64.exe), and can be rebuilt from that tag if ever needed. Never delete release assets or tags. CodeQL runs as GitHub default setup (a repository setting, not a workflow file): the operator removes go from its languages; workers never change repository settings, rulesets or branch protection. No Go-related check is required on master (required: Merge gate (task check), TypeScript (build + lint), Greptile Review), so the removal blocks no merge.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Go sources: delete go.mod, content/templates/embed.go and content/templates/embed_test.go.
2. Toolchain: drop go from MAINTAINER_TOOLS in packages/core/src/verify-env/toolchain-check.ts and from the maintainer probes in packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts; drop Go from the toolchain:check desc (tasks/toolchain.yml) and the setup:toolchain desc (tasks/setup.yml); update toolchain-check.test.ts, verify-env-cli.test.ts and retarget-dispatch.test.ts so they no longer use go as a probed tool.
3. CI: delete both Setup Go steps in .github/workflows/ci.yml; delete .github/workflows/release.yml (every job builds, smokes or uploads Go binaries, and verify-run-version only runs behind the disabled build); delete packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/release_workflow.test.ts; drop the gomod entry and Go comment lines from .github/dependabot.yml.
4. Bridge gates: delete packages/core/src/legacy-bridge/, packages/runtime/src/gates-cli/verify-go-freeze.* and verify-bridge-drift.*, and packages/core/src/release-e2e/legacy-bridge-leg.*; remove their wiring in packages/core/package.json (./legacy-bridge export), packages/core/src/index.ts, packages/runtime/src/dispatch.ts, tasks/verify.yml, Taskfile.yml, check/gate-lists.ts, check/context.ts (CITED_SKIP_BASELINE rows), check/named-cause.ts, product-first-done-gate/types.ts, and release-e2e main.ts, flags.ts and types.ts (--legacy-bridge flag); fix check/orchestrator.test.ts for the smaller baseline; drop the LAST_GO_INSTALLER comment in init-deposit/hygiene.ts.
5. Docs: docs/RELEASING.md and the release skill (content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md, then regenerate content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json) say the bridge binaries stay on the v0.58.0 release and Go is gone from master; docs/FILES.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md stop listing go.mod.
6. Add packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/go_retired_6863.test.ts asserting: no tracked *.go or go.mod; no setup-go in ci.yml; no release.yml; MAINTAINER_TOOLS has no go; no gomod in dependabot.yml; no packages/core/src/legacy-bridge directory.
7. One changelog fragment changelog.d/6863-retire-go.md.
